_comment: Files that are unreachable from the application entry point, and why that is a decision rather than an oversight. Every reason must be at least 40 characters, because an exemption that cannot be argued with is not a decision. An exemption that stops matching anything fails the audit — including when a module finally gets wired up, which is the good outcome and means this entry should be deleted.
backend:src/rail/catalog/pricing-sources: Controlled pricing-source register: the typed equivalent of docs/RAIL-PRICING-SOURCE-MATRIX-2026-10-02.md. Every row is deliberately UNVERIFIED with value null — never 0, never estimated — and a row can only be promoted with owner plus independent sign-off. It has no consumers because no rate has been signed off yet, which is the state it exists to enforce.
backend:src/driver-portal/journey.servic: Half-built WP3 vertical slice: the Journey and JourneyStage models exist and are RLS-protected, the service and its spec exist, but it is registered in no Nest module and the driver-portal controller exposes no journey endpoints. Deleting it alone would leave two tenant-isolated tables with no writer. Needs a product decision: finish the API or remove the whole slice.
backend:src/driver-portal/chat-idempoten: Used only by journey.service.ts, which is itself unwired. It dies with that service and should be removed in the same change as the journey slice, whichever way that decision goes.
backend:src/testing/fake-prisma.ts: Test infrastructure. An in-memory Prisma stand-in that is intentionally imported only by specs; it must never be reachable from main.ts, and reaching it would be the bug.
backend:src/test/tenant-prisma-mock.ts: Test infrastructure. Builds a tenant-scoped Prisma double for specs. Reaching it from main.ts would mean test scaffolding had leaked into the runtime.
backend:src/audit/audit-trail.testkit.ts: Test infrastructure. Helpers for asserting audit-trail writes in specs; referenced by scripts/local-prisma-stub.mjs. It belongs to the test world, not the runtime graph.
frontend:src/lib/railKpi.ts: Typed encoding of TRIM Annexure 43 (KPI framework, baselines, targets) from docs/TRIM-ANNEXURE-43-40-SUPPLIED-SOURCE-2026-10-04.md, with the source's recorded ambiguities preserved. Reference data awaiting a consumer; deleting it would discard a careful transcription of an authoritative document.
frontend:src/lib/railRunningTimes.ts: Typed encoding of TRIM Annexure 33a (point-to-point running times) from the supplied 2026-10-04 source. This is what makes 'late' measurable, so it is the reference the schedule comparisons will need. No consumer yet.
frontend:src/lib/railAncillaryServices.t: Typed encoding of the TRIM Annexure 40 ancillary services catalogue, transcribed from the supplied source and deliberately carrying no prices. Reference data awaiting a consumer, not abandoned scaffolding.
frontend:src/utils/aiHeuristics.ts: Speculative helper with a passing spec and no production consumer. Not hazardous and not duplicative, so it is exempted rather than deleted — but it is the weakest claim on this list and the first candidate to remove if it stays unused.
